<p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">Applications are now open for the Hurford Youth Fellows Program 2027, a fully funded youth leadership fellowship in the USA. Young leaders from around are eligible to apply for this program. The program lasts for four months, from May 1 to August 31, 2027. The good news is that you do not need IELTS or TOEFL to apply, and there is no application fee.</p>

</div>
</div>
</div>
<p><span style="color: #000000;">Hurford Programs is one of the best youth <strong><a href="https://scholarshipscorner.website/exchange-programs/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">exchange programs</a></strong>, where selected participants get in touch with global networks, democracy movements, and youth movements from all around the world. The main aim of the Hurford youth fellowship is to train potential young democracy activists and to build their leadership skills. </span><span style="font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, 'Noto Sans', sans-serif, 'Apple Color Emoji', 'Segoe UI Emoji', 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Noto Color Emoji';">The program brings young leaders from around the world to Washington, D.C., to work on projects, exchange ideas, and develop practical solutions to strengthen democracy and youth participation in decision-making.</span></p>
<p><span style="color: #000000;">The Hurford Youth Leadership Program is fully funded opportunity in the USA. All the expenses of the selected participants will be covered by the organization. Each fellow will receive a monthly stipend for living expenses, basic health insurance, and roundtrip travel to and from Washington, D.C. The fellows will have their own office including access to the internet and email. The program will also provide a stipend for long-distance phone calls. Don’t wait any longer and make sure to apply as soon as you can.</span></p>

<h2><span style="color: #000000;">Hurford Youth Fellowship Program 2027 in the USA:</span></h2>
<h3><span style="color: #000000;">Host Country:</span></h3>
<ul>
<li><span style="color: #000000;">The United States of America</span></li>
</ul>
<h3><span style="color: #000000;">Program Location:</span></h3>
<ul>
<li><span style="color: #000000;">Washington, D.C, USA.</span></li>
</ul>
<!-- Ezoic - wp_under_second_paragraph - under_second_paragraph --><div id="ezoic-pub-ad-placeholder-199" data-inserter-version="2" data-placement-location="under_second_paragraph"></div>

<ul>
<li><span style="color: #000000;">4-month international exchange program in the USA.</span></li>
</ul>
<h3><span style="color: #000000;">Program Dates:</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>May 1 to August 31</li>
</ul>

<h3><span style="color: #000000;">Hurford Youth Fellowship Program Benefits:</span></h3>
<div>
<div>
<ul>
<li>Monthly Stipend</li>
<li>Health Insurance</li>
<li>Free Round-Trip Air Tickets</li>
<li>Accommodation Expenses (Covered Through Stipend)</li>
<li>Opportunity to Research a Selected Topic Related to Democracy</li>
<li>Participation in the Global Youth Movement, Social Events, and Activities</li>
<li>Access to a Well-Equipped Office in Washington, D.C.</li>
<li>Limited Budget for Long-Distance Phone Calls</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
<h3><span style="color: #000000;">Eligibility Criteria Hurford Youth Fellowship Program 2025 in USA:</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>The program is open to applicants from all countries.</li>
<li><span style="color: #000000;">The candidate must not be older than 30 years.</span></li>
<li>Must demonstrate a commitment to promoting democracy.</li>
<li>Must have experience in youth participation and democratic activities.</li>
<li><span style="color: #000000;">Participants must know English.</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #000000;">The application form would be submitted in English.</span></li>
<li>For more detials about the eligiblity visit the official website.</li>
</ul>
<h3><span style="color: #000000;">How to Apply for Hurford Youth Fellowship Program 2027:</span></h3>
<ol>
<li><span style="color: #000000;">Go to the website where you can apply online.</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #000000;">Click on the option to create a new account. Enter your details and register. You’ll receive an email to confirm your account. Verify your email and log in.</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #000000;">Begin filling out your application, making sure to provide accurate information in all the required fields.</span></li>
<li><span style="color: #000000;">Submit your application before the deadline. It’s best not to wait until the last minute.</span></li>
</ol>
